name: work-smarter
description: Evidence-grounded research with direct adjacent-task handling and pre-draft verification, adaptive teaching and advice with research-backed learning plans, reusable instruction design and calibrated evaluation planning, personal-context indexing with authoritative record routing, and verified GitHub backup intake, reconciliation, and restoration for durable records.

interface.longDescription: Investigate substantive questions with current, high-quality evidence and explicit uncertainty. Build durable understanding and skills through adaptive teaching, practice, and research-backed learning plans. Provide evidence-grounded advice through applicable domain modules. Design, refine, and test prompts, instructions, skills, plugins, contracts, evaluations, and working-memory systems. Maintain a durable personal-context index that routes topics to their authoritative records. Run verified daily and weekly GitHub backups of configured durable records.
defaultPrompt: Design and test a reliable skill or plugin for this workflow.
Review these instructions for ambiguity, duplication, and misplaced content.
Research the current conventions, then improve this instruction package.
Teach me this concept or build a learning plan that develops durable capability.
Remember this reusable preference and keep its canonical source easy to find.
